---
title: "POLoPT Carbon"
---

POLoPT Carbon is a command-line tool that prepares carbon storage products for the
FAO PolOpT project. It combines a land cover raster with Ruesch & Gibbs IPCC Tier 1
biomass carbon values and the FAO Global Ecological Zones, then writes a carbon
density map, a carbon table, and tables for the InVEST Carbon Storage model.

## Install

Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/), then run:

```bash
uv tool install git+https://github.com/renatovargas/polopt_carbon
```

## Quick start

Check your inputs. This previews the results without writing any files:

```bash
polopt-carbon check lulc.tif boundary.shp
```

Then create the products:

```bash
polopt-carbon run lulc.tif boundary.shp --iso UGA --year 2023 -o out/uga
```

To keep your settings in a file, run `polopt-carbon init`, and then use
`polopt-carbon run --config polopt.yaml`.

To see the value each land cover class receives in a carbon zone, run:

```bash
polopt-carbon coefficients --region Africa --gez "Tropical rainforest"
```

To check a new run against earlier outputs, run:

```bash
polopt-carbon compare delivered_outputs new_outputs
```

Before using the results, read the [method notes](method.qmd), especially the
section on [known limitations](method.qmd#known-limitations).
